hook: Residents say HYDRAA is digging on *disputed* Sunnam Cheruvu land
hook_b: Residents say HYDRAA is digging on *disputed* Sunnam Cheruvu land
tldr: HYDRAA plans to open the restored Sunnam Cheruvu in the first week of December; SIET Maruthi Hills Colony residents say works are on their patta land in Survey Nos 12 and 13.

beats.what: The SIET Maruthi Hills Colony Welfare Association at Guttala Begumpet alleges HYDRAA is excavating, fencing and building compound walls on Survey Nos 12 and 13.
beats.why: The association says these are dry patta lands of the SIET Employees Co-operative Housing Society and not part of the lake bed; the case is in Writ Petition 6531/2025.
beats.care: It wants an independent, document-based survey and a halt to works until the court rules; it says it supports lawful lake rejuvenation.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: HYDRAA plans to inaugurate the restored lake in the first week of December. The association says arguments in the High Court case are over and judgment is reserved.

cards.q: Lake restoration vs disputed land: what should happen until the court rules?

qs: Who verifies lake boundaries when old records conflict?
What happens to finished works if the court rules either way?

facts.t: Residents allege *3* kinds of work on the plots: excavation, fencing and compound walls.

steps.e: Writ Petition 6531/2025 filed in High Court

viz.verdict: The court verdict and the planned opening are both pending.

viz.l: Plots the residents say are theirs

cover.label: Plots the residents say are theirs

learn.t: Patta = a land title record showing who owns a piece of land.

watch: The High Court's reserved verdict and whether the December inauguration goes ahead.
